historias: As an administrative staff member, I want to register patients with personal data and medical background, so that the hospital can maintain accurate records.
As an administrative staff member, I want to modify personal and contact details of a registered patient, so that information stays updated.
As an administrative staff member, I want to search for patients by name or identifier, so that I can locate records quickly.
As an authorized user, I want to visualize a patient's complete information, so that I can review relevant details.
As an administrative staff member, I want to create medical appointments associating patient, specialty, and professional, so that scheduling is accurate.
As an administrative staff member, I want to visualize doctors availability, so that I can plan appointments.
As a patient, I want notifications when my appointment changes, so that I stay informed.
As a doctor, I want to register diagnoses and treatments in the clinical record, so that care is documented.
As an administrator, I want to manage user roles and permissions, so that access is controlled.
As a pharmacist, I want to register medications with stock and expiration date, so that inventory is tracked.
As a receptionist, I want to create patient profiles including demographics and history, so that onboarding is complete.
As a receptionist, I want to update patient contact data, ensuring accuracy.
As hospital staff, I want quick patient lookup through filters, reducing waiting time.
As a clinician, I want to open a full patient dashboard, supporting informed decisions.
As a scheduler, I want to assign doctors to consultation slots automatically, preventing conflicts.
As a scheduler, I want to see a calendar view of doctor availability.
As patients, we want alerts when appointments are modified.
As physicians, we want structured electronic health record entries.
As system administrators, we want permission-based access control.
As pharmacy staff, we want automatic stock tracking for medicines.
As hospital front desk personnel, I want a unified workflow to register new patients with medical details.
As administrative personnel, I need to edit patient contact information when changes occur.
As staff, I want advanced search options for patient lookup.
As healthcare professionals, I want access to a consolidated patient overview page.
As coordinators, I want dynamic appointment booking aligning specialties and professionals.
As staff members, I want a visual planning board showing doctor schedules.
As patients, we want transparent notifications regarding appointment updates.
As clinicians, we want standardized documentation for treatments and progress.
As administrators, we want centralized management of roles and system permissions.
As pharmacy teams, we want alerts for medications nearing expiration.
